markets.rules_secondary:
This event concerns the conference affiliation of the team that wins the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball National Championship for the specified season. 

A team does not need to win its conference tournament or regular-season conference championship to qualify. Conference affiliation means the team's men's basketball conference as recognized by the NCAA when the NCAA tournament begins. 

“Other” includes every participating team that is not a member of the Big East, Big Ten, Big 12, Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC), or Southeastern Conference (SEC), including any independent team. Subsequent conference membership changes do not change the team's classification for this event. 

If a national champion is declared, its conference category resolves Yes and the other five categories resolve No. If the competition is cancelled or no champion can be determined, the parent contract's cancellation and indeterminate-outcome provisions apply; “Other” is not a no-champion outcome.

markets.rules_secondary:
A quadruple double is achieved when a player reaches 10 or more in four of the five main statistical categories in a single game: points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocks. Only a quadruple double in a regular season game counts. Preseason, playoffs (including the Play-In Tournament), the All-Star Game, and the NBA Cup Championship game are excluded. NBA Cup games before the Championship game are part of the regular season and do count.

markets.rules_primary: If the average of the Corrugated Recyclable Paper PPI in Q1 2027 is above 60 index points, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: This market uses the arithmetic mean of the three initially published BLS monthly values for Q1 2027 (WPU09120325; not seasonally adjusted; June 2006=100). For Q1 2027, the months are January, February, and March 2027. Add the three values, divide by three, and round to three decimal places, with a fourth decimal of 5 or greater rounded up. The rounded average must be strictly above the listed threshold. BLS is the primary source; FRED/ALFRED is secondary. Scheduled revisions are excluded. Material-error corrections and unavailable data follow the contract rules.
markets.title: Will the average corrugated paper PPI in Q1 2027 be above 60?

markets.rules_primary: If the Liberal Party wins the next Scarborough North federal by-election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A party's candidate is the candidate registered with Elections Canada under that party's name, or under a registered party it merges into; an independent or other-party candidate a party backs does not count. A candidate registered under a listed party's own name counts only for that party; if a candidate would otherwise count for more than one listed party through a merger, the candidate counts only for the first of them in the order Liberal Party, Conservative Party and NDP. A general election contest for this seat is not a by-election for this market.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

Important information: Negative values represent budget deficits. A higher, less-negative value represents a smaller deficit. For example, −4.0% is above −5.0%.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the election winner is officially declared or certified.
markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic Progressive Party wins the most seats in Taiwan’s 2027 Legislative Yuan by-elections for seats vacated by winners of the 2026 local elections, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For legislative elections, the winner is the party winning the most seats across the by-elections in scope.
In scope: every Legislative Yuan by-election held in 2027 to fill a regional or indigenous seat vacated by a legislator who won office in Taiwan’s November 28, 2026 local elections. markets.rules_primary: If the certified percentage of the popular vote received by Marine Le Pen in the first round of the next French presidential election is 25% to 100%, inclusive of both endpoints, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The percentage is Marine Le Pen's share of the valid votes cast in the first round (suffrages exprimés), calculated as votes received divided by total valid votes cast, times 100, rounded to 2 decimal places. Invalid, spoiled, blank, and rejected ballots are excluded from both numerator and denominator. If Marine Le Pen is not a candidate in the first round, the percentage for purposes of this market is 0%.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a qualifying special-session call occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Greg Abbott calls a new special session of the Texas Legislature before Gina Hinojosa takes office as Governor of Texas, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying call is a new official proclamation by Greg Abbott under Article IV, Section 8 of the Texas Constitution calling the Texas Legislature into special session. Any subject qualifies. The proclamation must be issued after Issuance and before Gina Hinojosa takes office as Governor of Texas (scheduled for Jan 19, 2027); the Legislature need not meet before that deadline.

An amendment that only adds subjects to an already-called session does not constitute a new call. Legislative requests, proposals, and announcements of plans to call a session do not qualify without the proclamation.

The number of new special sessions of the Texas Legislature called by Greg Abbott is counted from the Office of the Governor of Texas's official proclamation record. A record showing no qualifying call establishes a count of zero. If the official data needed to determine the count is unavailable by expiration, the contract's no-data provision applies.
markets.title: Will Abbott call a Texas special session before Hinojosa takes office?

markets.rules_primary: If Drake performs ,or it is announced that they will perform, at Coachella 2027 during the official event timeframe, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Performances on any official Coachella stage count. Performances on stages that are not part of the official festival do not count.

Additional clarification(s):

Drake appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

Drake actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or Drake's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of Drake’s anticipated performance at Coachella 2027. If an announced Drake later withdraws from Coachella 2027, this will not affect the resolution of the Contract.

The following constitutes a performance and IS encompassed by the Payout Criterion:

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Drake is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Drake performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Drake is present and actively performing, even if Drake's portion is partial.

A performance in which Drake performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within Coachella 2027.

A DJ set in which Drake is the performing DJ operating equipment live, regardless of whether Drake sings.

A pre-recorded performance segment presented as part of the official event program, provided it is attributed to Drake by the official event organizers and presented as a performance (rather than a tribute, retrospective, or archival clip).

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of Coachella 2027 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.

markets.rules_primary: If PRO wins the most votes in the 2027 Dutch provincial elections, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The winner is the party with the most votes in total across all twelve Provincial States elections held on March 17, 2027, counting the valid votes for each party's lists in every province. Elections held the same day for island councils, Senate electoral colleges and water boards do not count.
Votes are taken from the Kiesraad's national results for these elections; if no national total is published, the Kiesraad's twelve provincial results are added together.
PRO means Progressief Nederland.
A list submitted jointly by several parties counts only for the party named first in the list's name.
If two parties have the same total votes, the one with more seats across the twelve Provincial States resolves to Yes and all others to No.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.
markets.title: Will PRO win the most votes in the 2027 Dutch provincial elections?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of irregular migrants arriving in the Canary Islands by sea according to Spain's Interior Ministry is at least 30,000 in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The count is the "Canarias" figure for migrants arriving by sea in the Spanish Ministry of the Interior's irregular immigration report (Informe quincenal sobre inmigración irregular), cumulative from Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2026.
A market resolves to Yes as soon as a report in this series shows a Canarias figure of at least its number, even if a later report revises it.
Otherwise the first report with data through Dec 31, 2026 is used, and the market resolves once that report is published. Arrivals in Ceuta, Melilla, the Balearic Islands and the Peninsula do not count.
markets.title: Will at least 30,000 migrants reach the Canary Islands in 2026?

Resolution follows the final declared result, not the provisional count published on election night

In case of exact ties, markets resolve proportionally (1/number of tied entities). Write-in candidates achieving the specified rank resolve all named candidate markets to NO unless a specific "Write-in" or "Other" option exists. Candidates who withdraw or are disqualified after the filing deadline but remain on the ballot are ranked based on seats awarded.

markets.rules_primary: If BJP wins the next Manipur Legislative Assembly election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The winner is the party winning the most seats in the 60-seat Manipur Legislative Assembly, as declared by the Election Commission of India. Seats count by the party symbol on which the winning candidate contested; a party-backed independent does not count for the party, and a pre-poll alliance does not combine its members' seats unless they are registered as one party. Later defections and by-election results do not change the count. If two parties tie in seats, the one with the higher share of the valid votes polled across Manipur will resolve to Yes and all others to No.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation granting a Wyoming state entity (whether newly created or the Wyoming stable token commission with expanded powers) statutory authority to administer government-issued digital assets beyond the Wyoming stable token is enacted in Wyoming before Apr 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

Only a binding approval counts: a decision of the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee, including a central budget adjustment, authorizing the central government to issue additional treasury bonds, ultra-long special treasury bonds or special treasury bonds above the amount in the most recently approved annual central budget.
